activate.title: Activate NextHubX
activate.subtitle: Enter your activation token to connect to the NextHubX network

feedback.invalid: Activation token is invalid or expired, please contact your administrator
feedback.networkError: Network error, please try again later
feedback.unknown: Activation failed, please try again later

service.guideBody: NextHubX needs to install a background network service to create a global proxy adapter. The system will request administrator privileges (UAC on Windows / password on macOS). This is only required once.

fallback.title: Fell back to system proxy mode
fallback.body: The network service is not installed or permission was denied, so system proxy mode is used. Traffic from apps that ignore proxy settings may bypass the proxy.

gate.title: Network service required
gate.body: NextHubX needs to install a background network service to manage the global proxy adapter. The system will request administrator privileges (UAC on Windows / password on macOS). This is required only once; the app cannot be used until it is installed.
gate.supportBody: The network service could not be installed after several attempts. Please contact technical support for help and provide your system information.

account.title: Account
account.empty: No account information yet, please activate first

usage.title: How to use this account
usage.body: Use the Google account above (email + password) to sign in to the team services provisioned for you. Do not change the password, bind a personal phone number, or enable two-factor authentication, and do not use it for personal purposes. This account is for your work use only; contact your administrator if you run into sign-in issues.

sync.revokedNotice: Your seat has been revoked, please reactivate

clashVergeConflict.title: Clash Verge conflict detected
clashVergeConflict.runningBody: Clash Verge is running. It will compete with NextHubX for the same network service and cause your connections to keep dropping. Please close Clash Verge first.
clashVergeConflict.appearedBody: Clash Verge has just started. It will disconnect your connection. Please close it.
